tasks.subject: Task 0: Schema additions for per-survey ACL
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the SurveyVisibility enum, Survey.visibility field, SurveyAccess model, Membership.surveyAdmin field; regenerate Prisma client.

**Files:**
- Modify: `packages/database/schema.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- SurveyVisibility enum (private | public) exists
- Survey.visibility = SurveyVisibility @default(private)
- Survey.surveyAccess relation exists
- SurveyAccess model with composite PK (surveyId, userId), @@index([userId]), cascade deletes
- Membership.surveyAdmin Boolean @default(false)
- Prisma generate succeeds
- TypeScript compiles in apps/web

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` returns no errors related to new types.

```json:metadata
{"files":["packages/database/schema.prisma"],"verifyCommand":"cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json","acceptanceCriteria":["SurveyVisibility enum exists","Survey.visibility default private","SurveyAccess model with composite PK and userId index","Membership.surveyAdmin Boolean default false","Prisma generate succeeds","TypeScript compiles"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Data migration script
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Idempotent SQL migration that grants surveyAdmin=true to gcohen@asla.org and grandfathers existing surveys to visibility=public.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/2026-04-26-survey-acl-migration.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Aborts cleanly when target user missing
- Idempotent (re-run = 0 changes)
- Logs counts via RAISE NOTICE
- Wrapped in transaction

**Verify:** Run on local dev DB and inspect membership/visibility tables.

```json:metadata
{"files":["scripts/2026-04-26-survey-acl-migration.sql"],"verifyCommand":"psql $DATABASE_URL -f scripts/2026-04-26-survey-acl-migration.sql","acceptanceCriteria":["Aborts cleanly when target user missing","Idempotent","Logs counts via RAISE NOTICE","Wrapped in transaction"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Access check helper + tests (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure-function `canAccessSurvey` and `getSurveyAccessWhere` helpers in `apps/web/lib/survey/access.ts` with comprehensive Vitest tests.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/lib/survey/access.ts`
- Create: `apps/web/lib/survey/access.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- canAccessSurvey: !membership→false, surveyAdmin→true, public→true, creator→true, else SurveyAccess check
- getSurveyAccessWhere returns matching Prisma SurveyWhereInput fragment
- Tests cover all branches + where-clause sanity

**Verify:** `cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run lib/survey/access.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files":["apps/web/lib/survey/access.ts","apps/web/lib/survey/access.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run lib/survey/access.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["canAccessSurvey: 7 test cases pass","getSurveyAccessWhere: 3 test cases pass","No DB calls inside helpers","Pure function signatures"]}
```

- Modify: `apps/web/app/(app)/environments/[environmentId]/surveys/[surveyId]/(analysis)/layout.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Both layouts call canAccessSurvey
- Denied → notFound()
- Allowed → renders as today

**Verify:** Manual smoke — denied user sees not-found page; gcohen sees survey.
